name: Z.AI
short: GLM models on Z.AI's open platform (open.zhipuai.cn / docs.z.ai) and in ZCode, its official GLM-tuned IDE.

plans.name: Z.AI API pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: GLM 5.3 FlashX is the low-cost lane at $0.37/$1.25 per 1M; cached input $0.26 on the 5.x tier.

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan Lite
plans.notes: 10,000 credits/week (2,000 per 5 hours); works in ZCode, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode and 20+ agent tools.

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan Pro
plans.notes: 60,000 credits/week (12,000 per 5 hours); 6x Lite usage, curated MCP tools, faster generation.

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan Max
plans.notes: 140,000 credits/week (28,000 per 5 hours); 14x Lite usage, first access to new models, dedicated peak-time resources.
